description: This source file defines an Android Activity that demonstrates bitmap memory management and reuse techniques to optimize image loading performance in Android applications. It includes methods for creating and reusing bitmaps using BitmapFactory.Options, along with UI code for user interactions and measuring load times.

classes.name: BitmapAllocation
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating bitmap reuse to optimize memory and performance while loading images in an Android app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, prepares the bitmap reuse options, and defines click behavior to load next images with or without reuse.
